title: Multimodal Road Closure Mapping via Cross-Modal Graph Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.13192v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate and timely identification of road closures is critical for large-scale navigation and logistics systems, yet remains challenging due to the need to jointly reason over visual evidence, spatial context, and road network topology. Existing approaches either rely on manual map updates or focus on detecting closure-related objects without resolving which road segment is affected. In this work, we introduce a unified multimodal and multitask framework that jointly performs road closure classification (no, partial, complete) and road segment association within a single learning architecture. Our model integrates graph-structured map data, satellite imagery augmented with projected street-level detections, and street-view images using modality-specific encoders and cross-modal transformer attention, enabling explicit reasoning over visual cues and network topology. translated_title: 基于跨模态图注意力机制的多模态道路封闭制图
translated_abstract: 准确且及时地识别道路封闭对于大规模导航和物流系统至关重要，但由于需要同时对视觉证据、空间上下文和道路网络拓扑进行联合推理，该任务仍然充满挑战。现有方法要么依赖人工地图更新，要么仅专注于检测与封闭相关的目标物，而无法确定具体受影响的路段。在本工作中，我们提出了一个统一的多模态多任务框架，可在单一学习架构中同时完成道路封闭分类（无封闭、部分封闭、完全封闭）和路段关联两项任务。我们的模型采用模态专用编码器和跨模态Transformer注意力机制，整合了图结构地图数据、经投影街级检测结果增强的卫星影像以及街景图像，从而实现对视觉线索和网络拓扑的显式推理。该模型在从大规模采集的近2万个真实场景数据集上进行了评估……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个统一的多模态多任务框架，通过跨模态Transformer注意力整合图结构地图数据、卫星影像和街景图像，在单一架构中同时实现道路封闭分类与受影响路段的关联。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified multimodal multitask framework that leverages cross-modal transformer attention to integrate graph-structured map data, satellite imagery, and street-view images, jointly performing road closure classification and road segment association within a single learning architecture.
